bottleneck_forensic_analysis.bottleneck_1_sequential_worker_stepping: train_ppo.py steps workers in a single-threaded Python for-loop (`for i, env in enumerate(self.envs): env.step(a)`). Setting --envs 2 does NOT parallelize execution; it executes 2 environment steps sequentially per rollout step, doubling the environment work per rollout.
bottleneck_forensic_analysis.bottleneck_2_uncounted_validation_overhe: Validation was executed every 5 updates (31 times total) evaluating 5 plans for 25 steps each (= 125 env steps per validation). This injected 3,875 hidden environment steps (an uncounted 38.8% overhead over the 9,984 training steps), which took ~1,200 - 1,800 seconds and was excluded from the nominal SPS numerator.
bottleneck_forensic_analysis.bottleneck_3_alns_synthesis_in_env_step: Unlike standard discrete RL environments with O(1) state transitions, each ALNS environment step re-computes A* rectilinear shortest paths, Hanan routing grids, Held-Karp TSP, and full FloorPlanChecker validation. On standard (4-5 rooms) and complex (>=6 rooms) layouts, a single step takes 80-250 ms.
bottleneck_forensic_analysis.bottleneck_4_synchronous_checkpointing: Full PyTorch model, optimizer, RNG states, and training history (555 KB) were serialized to disk on every single update (156 times), adding synchronous disk I/O overhead.
